notes: This contract records the portable ordinary SendInteraction failure-report matrix. It verifies standard HLAreportServiceInvocation delivery, typed supplied and returned arguments, exception identity, serial progression, and application-callback suppression without provider-specific headers or registry access.

requirements.notes: The scenario drives invalid interaction-class, invalid parameter, and unpublished-class SendInteraction calls through the official C++ API. Both callback models decode all seven standard report parameters, verify the four standard supplied-argument records and Null returned argument, match exception names and serials zero through two, and prove no ordinary application callback is delivered. Provider configuration and FOM/MIM paths are supplied by the adapter.
